messages:
alex (AE): Heads-up — Medixa just escalated a compliance ask. They want a 24-month audit-log export capability with sampling + a 24h SLA on delivery. Also require PII redaction and proof of deletion for GDPR/HIPAA. Sending to product/security for scope + impact. Link to their ticket: https://drive.google.com/medixa-audit-req (see attachment).

maya (PM): Thanks Alex. Can you paste the exact fields they want in the export? Is this for hosted customers or Private deployment? We need to scope storage/cost and legal implications before committing any SLA.

olivia (support): Pasted from the ticket: "We need event-level auth & API call logs (ts, user_id, org_id, endpoint, status, latency, request_hash, response_hash). No full prompt/response bodies. Export format: ndjson or CSV. Retention: 24 months. Also need a mechanism to request per-user deletions that cascade to exports (GDPR)." Ticket includes a sample row.

medixa-prodops (customer): Confirming — correct. We cannot store full prompts. We need hashes to map to our internal records. Important: exports must not contain PII. If you can provide a pseudonymization toggle that keeps linkable but non-identifiable user ids, that's acceptable. We may request scheduled monthly exports too.

jin (security): Flags — 24 months + export access + pseudonymization is doable but requires: (1) documented de-id algorithm and threat model, (2) customer-managed keys for encryption at rest for Private deployments or dedicated KMS for Hosted, (3) audit of the export job (who requested, when, output checksum). For HIPAA we need a BA agreement addendum before enabling longer retention. Also: default platform retention policy is 90 days; any extension needs a retention exception workflow and change to retention enforcer.

noah (eng): A few quick questions to estimate effort: export schema (JSON vs CSV), expected data volume (avg events/day), and sampling rate options (e.g., 100%, 10%, 1%). Implementation approaches: streaming job that scans time window + filters -> ndjson gzip chunks to s3/gs + downloadable signed URL, or on-demand full dump. Example internal command prototype:
```
POST /internal/admin/logs/export
body: {"start":"2024-01-01","end":"2026-01-01","fields":["ts","user_hash","org_id","endpoint","status","latency"],"sampling":0.01,"pii_mode":"pseudonymize"}
```
We need to add a retention exception flag to the enforcer and an export-job service that is rate-limited.

maya (PM): Proposed product options (tradeoffs):
- Option A (Quick, supported by support): Manual export handled by Support with a manual redaction pass, SLA 48-72h for <=200GB. Low dev effort; operational cost.
- Option B (Medium): Add an admin export API + sampling + pseudonymization toggles for Hosted customers with dedicated KMS. Job-based delivery via signed URL. SLA: 48h for <=1TB, 7 days for >1TB. Requires eng work + security sign-off.
- Option C (Enterprise): Full retention extension + long-term archive + self-serve controls for Private / Dedicated customers. Contract addendum, pricing uplift.

Acceptance criteria for Option B (minimum viable):
- /admin/logs/export API with filters by time/org/event type and sampling param
- Pseudonymization option documented and reversible only by customer mapping (or irreversible salted hash)
- Export job audit trail + checksum + signed URL delivery
- RBAC such that exports require owner+support approval flow
- Security sign-off and legal BA addendum for HIPAA customers
- Pricing note + retention exception UI flow

paul (legal): Addendum needed for >90d retention and for any scenario where customer data mapping could re-identify users. Also we need to document deletion guarantees and proof-of-deletion process.

alex (AE): Customer will need an answer by EOW. If we can offer Option A as interim, that might buy time. Can support do that today?

olivia (support): I can do manual exports. I'll need a runbook and a security checklist from Jin. I'll open a SOC ticket to log manual exports and charge a one-off operational fee.

jin (security): I'll draft the runbook + checklist. For manual exports: require manual de-id review, store output in encrypted bucket with 30d TTL, and produce sha256 checksum and audit entry. That's our temporary control.

noah (eng): For backlog: estimate 2-3w spike for prototype + 4-6w for full feature (API, job service, KMS integration, retention exception). If prioritized P2 we can aim for an initial beta in 8-10 wks.

maya (PM): Triage decision: log as a new product ticket, priority P2 (customer-impacting but gated by contract). Owner: maya (PM). Next steps: 1) Olivia to deliver manual-export runbook by tomorrow, 2) Jin to produce security checklist + BA requirements in 3 days, 3) Noah to kick off eng spike and provide rough storage/cost estimate in 1 week, 4) Paul to draft retention addendum language. I'll post spec doc in product drive and link the ticket.

alex (AE): Sounds good — I'll tell the customer we'll provide a manual export option immediately and a timeline for the hosted API export.

olivia (support): Filed support case -> #INC-4521. Noted operational fee option. Will coordinate with medixa for sample validation. :thumbsup:

maya (PM): I'll create the product ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PRD-8892 and add everyone. If anyone has objections to P2, flag now. Otherwise moving to backlog grooming.

paul (legal): No objections. Please add that BA/BAA review is gating production rollout.

medixa-prodops (customer): Appreciate the quick cycle. We'll review manual export and provide sample mapping to validate hashes.

maya (PM): Closing thread — going to summarize in the PRD and schedule a kickoff. Thanks team. :seedling:
